title: HYPoxaEmic Respiratory Failure and Awake Prone Ventilation
official: HYPoxaEmic Respiratory Failure and Awake Prone Ventilation
summary: The goal of this prospective multi-centre randomised controlled trial is to determine if addition of awake prone positioning to standard oxygen, high flow oxygen therapy and non-invasive ventilation may reduce the rates of endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation.

sites.f: Barking, Havering and Redbridge University Hospitals NHS Trust
